Bihar ki rajdhani patna ke phulvari shariph thane men ek behad hairan karne vala aur khaki ko sharmasar karne vala mamla samne aaya hai. madak padarthon ki kharid-bikri ke khilaph chhapemari ke dauran pakre gae do aaropiyon ko kathit taur par moti rakam (rishvat) lekar thane se hi chhor dene ke ganbhir aarop men 5 ASI (pulis avar nirikshak) aur 3 sipahiyon samet kul 8 puliskarmiyon ko nilanbit kar diya gaya hai. sath hi un par FIR darj kar jel bhejne ki taiyari ki ja rahi hai.
